scope: Python transport and validation-boundary regression tests only; no Rust, Fortran or Symbolica execution
duration_qualification: validation observation, not a performance benchmark

fixes.issue: A large prepare request could block in stdin.write before its timeout began.
fixes.change: Use nonblocking stdin/stdout with a shared monotonic deadline, drain both pipe directions, and kill/reap a timed-out child.
regressions: 4 MiB input to a child that never reads times out
large duplex traffic and persistent second response
EOF without a result exits promptly

fixes.issue: Interruption between configurations could leave an incomplete run marked complete.
fixes.change: Record all configurations before execution; retain interrupted and not_run rows; require normal completion of all rows.

fixes.issue: zip could silently compare fewer than three MadLoop Laurent coefficients.
fixes.change: Require exactly three finite real/imaginary pairs and strict pairing.
regressions: selected graph, color factor and all Laurent slots

runtime_smoke: pending on a provenance-identified Rust binary
matched_physical_timings: not qualified; routing, snapping, effective/generated rank and stage boundaries still require alignment
